title: Choose what holds under pressure
objective: Translate a professional value into a visible leadership decision under deadline pressure.

title: Develop the person who catches the ball
objective: Design a repeated coaching action and a test of independent performance.

title: Distinguish willingness from a missing skill
objective: Use observed behavior and a coached retry to assess a development need.

title: Ask what the work is for
objective: Build a development assignment around an employee’s stated goal and motivation.

title: Steady the room when the deadline slips
objective: Identify a stress signal and deliver a short operational reset during a deadline.

title: Set the stage for the next person
objective: Redesign a physical or digital work environment so a handoff is easier to execute.

title: Make the private correction useful
objective: Conduct a timely one-on-one correction and define a follow-up observation.

title: Record the truth and notice the good catch
objective: Write a factual coaching note and deliver specific recognition for a repeatable behavior.

title: Diagnose what really keeps repeating
objective: Distinguish a system breakdown, a supervisor effect, and an individual performance issue.

title: Lead a reset that survives your absence
objective: Create a culture-reset plan with a visible standard, an owner, and a follow-up measure.
